goals.description: Add a scoped accepted-wire handle in src/tessera/cached_unit.py. verify_cached_unit must keep the parsed container in this handle. A tiny valid immutable wire must reach the real container parser exactly once. This holds across cached-unit verification and accepted-wire decoding. A test must count the calls at the real container parser (tessera.container.parse as imported by cached_unit and unit_artifact). The test must use a self-contained tiny-wire fixture, with no model download.

Add an additive accepted-wire decode path. Extract the metadata construction from parse_unit_metadata into a shared helper that takes a parsed artifact. The ordinary bytes-taking reader must use the same helper. The accepted-wire path must return the same metadata and the same decoded values as read_unit_artifact on the same bytes. It must still run every metadata, profile, plane, geometry and reconstruction check. A test must compare metadata and decoded values between the two paths.

Add refusal tests that go through the real reader. Cover these cases: corrupt wire bytes, receipt mismatch (size, sha256 and record fields), expected-identity mismatch, incomplete planes (terminal prefix), wrong recipe, a handle that verification did not issue (foreign handle, including a handle for other bytes), and malformed metadata. Each case must refuse. The accepted-wire path must refuse whatever the ordinary reader or verify_cached_unit refuses. Existing refusal behavior must not change.

Keep the retained parse inside the scoped accepted-wire handle. Add no process-global digest-to-artifact cache. Add no extra copy of the large plane region. The retained parse must have a bounded lifetime. Existing bytes-taking APIs (read_unit_artifact, parse_unit_artifact, parse_unit_metadata, verify_cached_unit, make_unit_record) must keep their signatures and behavior. Callers that use AcceptedUnit.blob, .manifest and .wire_bytes must keep working. Keep serialized bytes, receipt fields, recipes, historical-producer verification and serving admission unchanged. Do not repeat the plane-region digest fix in container.parse.

Run the new and changed tests through PrismaBuild run_tests with the native_threads_2 runner feature. Cover tests/test_cached_producer.py and tests/test_cached_unit_reader_gamut.py. Run the read-only controls tests/test_parse_digest_once.py, tests/test_compact_loader.py, tests/test_issue_refs.py and tests/test_impacted_tests.py. Record the exit status, logs, terminal verdict, CAS receipts, skips and missing tools. Report any detail that the receipt does not show (priority -10, admitted CPU and memory, worker count) as a gap. Do not report it as observed. Do not run any GPU work.

Independent checking must run the targeted tests again through PrismaBuild. It must confirm that the new parse-count and refusal tests pass on the head. It must confirm that the new tests are self-contained, with no GPU, checkpoint or model download. It must confirm that the diff stays inside the declared footprint and touches no protected path.

objections: Existing check must name a test defined at the base: tests/test_impacted_tests.py::test_reads_every_doc. A new assertion observer needs a demonstrating check; adding it only at head cannot repair an original-base regression.
projection_note: Completed planner declarations only. Model-span drafts were truncated. Tests supply synthetic base source facts, not a reconstructed repository.
